usedFor: Parma holds relationships, and Slack receives alerts through “Send Message” when a new one is added.

bestTemplate.name: “New Relationship” in Parma, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team sees each new relationship in a channel and can pick it up.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for approval today, and “New Relationship” in Parma is polling.
